sources.evidence_scope: Legal identity of each 2026 East/West ward and the same-named 2024 electoral division
sources.evidence_text: Articles 47(2)(c) and 49(2)(c), with Schedules 1 and 2, state that each new 2026 ward has the same area as the county council electoral division of that name under the 2024 Order.
